old/vista-halo.2026-10-16.webp.prompt:
A painted vista for the landing screen of a space trading game: futuristic, painterly, a cinematic matte painting with visible brushwork, wide 16:9. No text, lettering, logos, UI, borders or frames.

Prism art direction: slightly retro corporate futurism, like a 1970s or 1980s corporate brochure or airbrushed space art: smooth white curves, chrome trim and tinted glass, soft gradient skies, gentle pastel accent lights, a polished optimistic sheen that feels a little dated and a little too perfect.

Art bible for the Serein system. Palette: off-white, pale aqua, deep sea blue, olive, peach and rust brown. Lighting: Soft, even yellow-white daylight with no hard shadows. Glass and white surfaces bounce it until the streets seem lit from nowhere. Dusk comes in warm gold, with the windows glowing and the towers going faintly pink. Interiors are lit by diffused panels in a slightly too-perfect white. Architecture: Tall white towers with unbroken curtain walls, set in clipped gardens and long reflecting pools. Streets are wide, empty and silent. Orbital habitats are smooth rings with scented, softly lit corridors. There are no signs, only discreet glyphs, and no visible joins or vents anywhere. Materials: White composite, polished glass, pale stone, brushed pale metal, clipped green lawn, still water. Nothing is rusted, scuffed, welded or patched, and the few scuffs that appear are gone by morning. Mood: Hushed, spotless, expensive and watchful. It is a calm that feels like being observed by a kindly stranger who never blinks. Dry humour sits just under it. Design language: Prism's sleek, seamless language: white, glass and light, rounded and unjoined, clean luxury with an unsettling calm. Staff wear pale tailored clothes with a small company mark, and every object looks designed to be unremarkable.

The place: Halo Clinics, the research station of the system, a habitat ring in open space between the worlds. A busy place of tens or hundreds of millions: built up all round the port, with ships coming and going. Serein, a water world: deep sea blue seas, olive green lowlands and off-white highlands with snow on the peaks, under drifting white cloud; its sky is pale sky blue, and its settlements show warm lights at dusk, hangs huge in the sky. The light comes from a yellow star.

The scene: The dock opens onto a long white curve of the habitat ring, smooth and seamless, lit by soft diffused light that casts almost no shadow. A broad window runs along one side, and through it hangs Serein below, deep sea blue seas, olive lowlands and off-white highlands under drifting white cloud, catching the yellow starlight. Far off, a faint rust brown speck with a glittering haze marks Vell. The dock deck is spotless, with a few pale-clad staff moving along the curve and a scattering of small clinic craft moored like pearls.

Composition: keep the left two fifths of the image darker and calmer, with no focal point there, because the port's text panel is drawn over it; the main interest sits right of centre.

The attached image is this system's style reference, for the painting only: match its brushwork, finish and treatment of light. Take nothing else from it: not its landscape, sea, cliffs, buildings, rings or layout. The ground, sky and colours come from the description above.
